scored.para_que: Everything rests on this: the dashboard, the daily queue and the prioritisation all come from here. If it is stale, the whole program shows yesterday's picture.

gestiones.para_que: Feeds the per-agent analytics, the ranking and the monthly trend. When it lags, the team looks less active than it actually was.

calidad.para_que: The scores given to each interaction. With no new loads, the quality panel keeps repeating last month.

cartera_real.para_que: The portfolio the client uploads, when the program is not running on the synthetic demo.

modelo.para_que: The model behind the probability of payment. It is retrained when the portfolio changes, not every day.

motivo.sin_datos: It has never been loaded in this installation.
motivo.manual: Uploaded by hand: it does not expire with age.
motivo.atrasada: A {frecuencia} load was expected and the last one was {hace} ago ({atraso} later than planned).

titular.todo_al_dia: Every table is up to date.
